The sign-off request requires all four statements (opinion, limitations, material_overrides, rationale) as non-blank BoundaryText (blank and bidi-override refused at the contract), the signed record stores them and freeze refuses OPINION_SIGNOFF_REQUIRED without a current one; the HTTP route round-trips the same fields.

The browser's disabled Freeze control before sign-off was exercised only against fixture-mocked routes.

opinion_history retains the superseded opinion beside its successor (supersedes_opinion_id), UPDATE/DELETE on deliverable_opinions are refused by APPEND_ONLY triggers, and each opinion binds the exact draft revision digest, accepted snapshot id, source-set id/version, model-identity digest and methodology build, digested over the whole record; the two-connection PostgreSQL race leaves one head. The supporting snapshot itself is retained by the immutable runs store and referenced by id.

A draft composes from the accepted snapshot's verified artifacts (fails closed without accepted authority or on a forged artifact digest), the registry template, and a model selection that must resolve to the exact validated build or signed revision (MODEL_REVISION_STALE / MODEL_BUILD_STALE otherwise). 'Qualified' here means validated build or signed revision; live-model qualification of the underlying analysis is external (MOD family).

Only template-declared optional kinds, slots, caps and order are accepted (DELIVERABLE_SLOT_INVALID, DELIVERABLE_TEMPLATE_ORDER_INVALID), ungoverned metric ids and chart recipe fields are refused, and client-supplied document sections are a 422.

Citations must resolve to same-case, existing, non-withdrawn blocks before a save appends; generated metrics, tables and scenario exhibits are rebuilt server-side from the pinned revision and refused on digest or calculation mismatch; accepted artifact bytes are re-verified at composition.

Analyst narrative and the opinion are ANALYST-origin, editable sections; generated fact and model sections are locked with MODEL/ARTIFACT origin; the origin labels survive into Markdown, PDF and XLSX (goldens) and the opinion leads the decision page.

The external opinion exists only as a named analyst's signed record carrying opinion, limitations, material_overrides and rationale, bound to the exact revision; freeze and filing carry the signer. The material_overrides statement is required non-blank but no test links it to the concrete model overrides in the analyst revision.

Saves are content-addressed revisions appended under an expected-version CAS; racing saves yield one winner and one typed conflict carrying the committed head, on SQLite and on two PostgreSQL connections.

The losing save appends no revision and no deliverable.draft.saved audit event (exactly one event per appended revision); a stale HTTP PUT is a 409 with the current revision embedded; an order violation appends nothing.

Later edits and restores are proven to leave prior revisions byte-identical. After a source withdrawal the tests assert only that sign-off and citation saves are refused (EVIDENCE_SOURCE_WITHDRAWN); after model supersession only that filing is refused (FROZEN_MODEL_AUTHORITY_STALE); neither reads revision_history back. deliverable_revisions has no append-only trigger test (the tamper test writes the row directly). Needs a test that withdraws a cited source and supersedes the model, then asserts the full history is still served unchanged.

Snapshot, source-set and draft-revision changes are surfaced as a stale opinion state with typed reasons (ACCEPTED_SNAPSHOT_CHANGED, SOURCE_SET_CHANGED, DRAFT_REVISION_CHANGED) and freeze refuses; a moved model revision is a typed refusal at save, freeze and filing. Not covered: the draft itself carries no stale marker (staleness lives on the opinion state), and no test changes the template or the methodology authority under a draft (templates are static in the registry; runs pin the build). Needs a design call on the draft-level marker plus template/methodology staleness tests.

Freeze is refused while any bound authority (draft revision, source set, accepted snapshot, model identity, methodology) is stale and succeeds only after the analyst re-signs on the current revision; an application-build fallback requires an explicit acknowledgement. Acknowledgement is the re-sign binding all authorities at once, not a per-dependency acknowledgement record.

The frozen payload pins draft id/version/digest, template id and version, accepted snapshot and source set, model identity with the signed revision's outputs and assumptions verbatim, the methodology build id, the opinion, and the cited evidence set (payload['evidence'], asserted present in every format by the goldens); a tampered stored revision or a moved source set is refused.

Six states render md/pdf/xlsx from one frozen payload and match identifier-normalised goldens; the same payload renders identical PDF bytes twice; every pathway renders all three formats; PDF glyphs come only from the digest-verified vendored DejaVu bundle; a divergent render for a published identity is DELIVERABLE_FREEZE_CONFLICT. The retained backend gate ran on the developer host, not inside the worker image, so on-image determinism is not retained for this candidate.

The FROZEN record and deliverable.frozen event exist only after every export is published hash-addressed and read back with its digest and size verified; a retry after publish-but-before-commit converges on the same record. Exercised in-process through run_pending_freezes, not through the worker container on the image.

A renderer crash leaves a FAILED job with DELIVERABLE_RENDER_FAILED (message never persisted), no frozen record, no deliverable.frozen event and no half-published export; a missing export refuses filing and keeps the gate parked; a font bundle failing verification refuses to render.

Export filenames are not user-derived: the deliverable export route serves bytes with x-caos-sha256 and no Content-Disposition, the audit package names itself from the server case id, and upload filenames are canonicalised at the source route ('../../escape.txt' -> 'escape.txt'). Document metadata (PDF Info dictionary, XLSX docProps creator/dates) is not asserted by any retained test beyond byte-determinism (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=0 pinned by the goldens). Needs a test reading PDF/XLSX metadata and, if a download filename is ever added, its sanitisation.

An '=HYPERLINK(...)' narrative reaches the workbook as an escaped literal string (data_type 's'), no cell in any sheet has data_type 'f', and model numbers stay typed floats; the renderer also raises DELIVERABLE_EXPORT_UNSAFE if a formula reaches the workbook. The signed model export is asserted formula-free in the distressed overlay spec.

POST /api/cases/{id}/members provisions an APPROVER over HTTP (analyst 403, reader 403, outsider 404 even as global ADMIN, invalid role 422) and that approver files; the opinion signer and the freeze actor are refused APPROVER_NOT_INDEPENDENT (403) even with approver standing; filing needs stored case APPROVER/ADMIN standing plus a current global writer role.

Approval carries exactly preview_digest and input_fingerprint; a mismatch on either is refused and the record stays FROZEN and retryable; the gate hash is the canonical sha256:<preview_digest> form only; caller-owned authority fields are 422; the receipt records the bound digest, fingerprint and approval hash.

Bytes: tampered frozen content or substituted export metadata is refused. Dependency: a superseded snapshot, a forged accepted artifact, a newer active model revision, or an authority move mid-approval is refused inside the CAS. Standing: membership revoked between authorization and commit, or a downgraded global role, refuses at commit. Source status: a source-set change between freeze and filing is refused. Every refusal leaves the record FROZEN with no audit residue. A post-freeze withdrawal of a cited source is covered only through the source-set version it moves.

Two concurrent approvers yield one FILED record, one receipt and one deliverable.filed event, with the loser refused RESUME_NOT_APPLIED; proven in-process and on two PostgreSQL connections (SIM-017); a duplicate resume is a 409, never a second filing.

Downloads serve the stored bytes whose sha256 and size equal the frozen record (never re-rendered, even by an instance whose renderer explodes); a tampered export is DELIVERABLE_EXPORT_INTEGRITY_FAILED (409) and a missing one DELIVERABLE_EXPORT_UNAVAILABLE, with no audit residue; served downloads are audited. Proven through the app's TestClient, not through the Caddy edge on the image.

The packaged filed export bytes are scanned for source block text, vault paths, session/edge secrets, api_key/authorization, prompt/system_prompt/messages and found clean; the approver identity never appears in any format; renderers walk payload.publication only. Not asserted: exclusion of draft comments (a request-changes comment is appended to the replacement draft and no test freezes after it), hidden controls, case notes or other non-publishable notes, and provider traces beyond the identity disclosure. Needs a fixture seeding each of those and scanning md/pdf/xlsx.

Every format carries the source register and citations, limitations, machine-assistance line, analyst opinion and owner, approval state PENDING APPROVAL, as-of date, draft version and the draft/content digests and input fingerprint (asserted by the parity checks and pinned by the normalised Markdown golden); the approver identity lives only in the append-only detached receipt and the approved bytes are untouched by filing. No intended-approver prebinding feature exists, so the 'unless prebound' clause has no path. The fixture's as-of date renders 'Unavailable' because the seeded acceptance carries no date.

The mechanical half is proven: 'Analyst judgment' versus 'Locked · model/artifact/system' origin labels, limitations, the opinion and its owner, and source ids are present in Markdown, PDF and XLSX for six states, and effective assumptions ride the model appendix. Whether an external reader can actually distinguish them is REV-006 Q1 (clarity, source disclosure, limitations, terminology), OUTSTANDING.

A change request moves the record to CHANGES_REQUESTED with the frozen exports unchanged byte for byte, appends a traceable replacement draft carrying the comment, requires an approver and a non-blank comment, and rolls back entirely on a revision conflict.

A later filing marks the prior FILED record SUPERSEDED with superseded_by_id and terminalises its thread; the record and its content-addressed exports are never rewritten or re-rendered. The export route serves SUPERSEDED records, but no retained test downloads a superseded filed export after refiling.

No transmission surface exists: the 59 audited routes are case, source, run, model, deliverable and audit reads and writes, and export is a download. But absence is not asserted: the retained sec-audit artifact holds only the summary line, the OpenAPI walk pins no route inventory, and the upload-only tests ban inbound acquisition patterns, not outbound sending; no connector-authorisation policy exists to test. Needs a pinned route inventory test asserting no outbound side effect and a recorded decision on connector authorisation.
